moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio iris-open, written here): Circular clip centred on the subject: radius 0 → 1.5 × half the box diagonal (150 %) in 760 ms power3.out (easeOutQuart); a 1.5 px accent ring rides the edge until it passes the corners. Before it, a 4 px accent dot pops at the centre (250 ms back.out) and shrinks away as the iris opens (150 ms). Site exit: fade 320 ms. Params: duration (0.76 s) · x, y: tâm vòng (50 %) · rim: viền mép (1.5 px) · ease (power3.out).
